title: Jaaneman
description: Suhaan, an aspiring actor, is in a fix when Piya files for divorce and forces him to pay a large amount as alimony. To avoid paying her, Suhaan uses Agastya's love for Piya and helps him woo her.

title: Bewafai
description: Asha's jealousy gets the better of her when she finds out that the man she loves, Ashok, is showering attention to Vinny, a woman Asha beats up later, and Renu, a woman who has a cognitive disorder.

title: Ajanabee
description: Middle-classed Rohit (Rajesh Khanna) falls in love with rich Reshmi (Zeenat Aman) and marries her. But fate has other plans and he gets arrested for the murder which he never committed.

title: Agni Sakshi
description: Newly married Suraj and Shivangi are on honeymoon where they meet Vishwanath - who claims that Shivangi is his wife.

title: Anurodh
description: A rich businessman disapproves of his son's passion for singing. This leads to friction between them, causing the boy to leave home. He adopts a new identity when he becomes a popular singer.

title: Aandhi Toofan
description: Inspector Ranjeet nabs the notorious biker-gangster Balbir, but the criminal soon manages to escape and swears vengeance against the police officer and his family.

title: Awaaz
description: Advocate Jayant defends his clients and gets them off the hook, even if they are guilty. However, when his daughter is raped by the son of a gangster he has defended, he vows to take revenge.

title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 2
description: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

title: Baharon Ki Manzil
description: A woman (Meena Kumari) whose memory is impaired learns shocking information about her family.

title: Comedy Station - Bittu Bak Bak
description: Series of short, comedic vignettes where an unlucky Bhojpuri producer Champaklal and his secretary Suzie hilariously navigate chaotic, low-budget filmmaking, trying to outsmart each other.

title: Ajnabee Saaya
description: Rakesh's wife dies, then returns. He's shocked and suspicious, trying to uncover her identity.

title: Meherbaan
description: Meherbaan is the story of a family man, who has to decide between commitment, ethics and love between his 2 women.

title: Shakti
description: Ashwini, an honest policeman, refuses to trade a captured gangster for his son Vijay's release after a ruthless gangster kidnaps him. Vijay grows up resenting his father and turns to a life of crime.

title: Safar
description: A pair of lovers are cruelly separated by destiny when the boy is diagnosed with terminal cancer. On his insistence, the girl settles down with another man, but he turns out to be a jealous husband.

title: Professor Ki Padosan
description: Vidyadhar consumes a potion to become invisible in order to escape his wife Shobha's ire when she learns of his affair with Menka.

title: An Evening In Paris
description: A wealthy woman meets a charming but not completely truthful beau in France.
